completionPolicy: Discussion, indexing, source counts, generic templates and blocked labels are not completion. Close an aspect only when its source audit, operational authored coverage, adversarial review and appropriate validation are evidenced. Any intentionally excluded option needs an explicit reviewed disposition, not a blanket unfinished status. Human sessions, numerical balance and publication approval remain separate gates.
